note: Every number below is a starting point, NOT a validated value. Re-tune against er_gold_set.csv (and a larger gold set) before use.

address.note_road_suffix: same lane/number but road suffix 路 vs 街 differs (typo-level variation)

name.note_idf: character bigrams weighted by 1/(1+ln(document frequency)) over the district's name corpus, so shared common tokens (家, 肉粽, 小吃) count little

geo.note: tax registry has no coordinates until geocoded; geo contributes 0 when either side lacks coordinates

guard_rails: never auto_match when category veto applies
never auto_match from name alone when either side has an address and they differ (route to probable/review)
